headline: 3 killed in shooting at In-N-Out Burger in Idaho, US
summary: At least two others were left critically injured after a gunman entered the restaurant's dining area on Saturday afternoon.
details: At least three people were killed and two others critically injured in a shooting at an In-N-Out Burger restaurant in Twin Falls, Idaho.
The incident occurred around 2:30 PM local time on Saturday, August 1, when a gunman entered the dining area and opened fire.
Police have stated that the suspected shooter is also dead, although it is not yet clear if the shooter is included in the total death toll of three.
The Twin Falls Police Department temporarily closed nearby roads and a bridge for security reasons as the investigation into the motive began.
Idaho Senator Mike Crapo and other state representatives expressed their condolences to the victims and praised the rapid response of emergency services.
The event adds to a growing trend of shootings in public spaces like food festivals, places of worship, and social gatherings across the United States.
caption:
A peaceful Saturday afternoon turned deadly in Idaho as a gunman opened fire inside a popular burger chain.

At least three people were killed and two others critically injured in a shooting at an In-N-Out Burger restaurant in Twin Falls, Idaho.

The incident occurred around 2:30 PM local time on Saturday, August 1, when a gunman entered the dining area and opened fire.

Police have stated that the suspected shooter is also dead, although it is not yet clear if the shooter is included in the total death toll of three.

The Twin Falls Police Department temporarily closed nearby roads and a bridge for security reasons as the investigation into the motive began.

Idaho Senator Mike Crapo and other state representatives expressed their condolences to the victims and praised the rapid response of emergency services.

The event adds to a growing trend of shootings in public spaces like food festivals, places of worship, and social gatherings across the United States.

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo

headline_marked: Lionel [[Messi returns to action]] for Inter Miami in 2-2 draw
headline: Lionel Messi returns to action for Inter Miami in 2-2 draw
summary: The Argentine star made his first competitive appearance since the World Cup final, though Miami missed a chance to move to the top of the MLS standings.
details: Lionel Messi returned to competitive action for Inter Miami today, marking his first appearance since Argentina's World Cup final defeat to Spain. He came off the bench in the 53rd minute, while fellow Argentine Rodrigo De Paul also returned to the lineup as a starter.
caption:
Lionel Messi is back on the pitch! ⚽️

Lionel Messi returned to competitive action for Inter Miami today, marking his first appearance since Argentina's World Cup final defeat to Spain. He came off the bench in the 53rd minute, while fellow Argentine Rodrigo De Paul also returned to the lineup as a starter.
